sampling: sqrt class counts, uniform patient conditional on class; replacement; unweighted loss
augmentation: shift +/-3 normalized samples; scale .9-1.1; noise sd .02; only training; no extra-feature fusion with augmentation
features: 10 fixed real-time local descriptive features; energy width is not clinical QRS duration
selection: max validation macro-F1 at seed0; repeat baseline and selected seeds1,2 without choosing seed
test: none; development validation reused; no fresh holdout claim
budget: 10 seed0 configs then 2 seeds each for baseline and winner
